provenance: Synthetic text drafted by the assistant for user review; no real customer records.

tickets.message: After importing a CSV, all 240 contacts that I saved last week disappeared from this workspace. Search and clearing filters do not bring them back. Please call me to help recover them.
I merged two duplicate contacts. The notes saved on both records are now blank, and refreshing does not restore them. The contacts themselves are still present.
Our shared address book had twelve saved groups yesterday. Today six groups and their saved membership lists are missing for every teammate. Could someone phone me about this?
I changed one contact name and clicked Save. A different contact, saved months ago, vanished and is absent from the trash. I have not recovered it.
The nightly sync removed the saved company addresses from dozens of contact cards. I can still see the names, but the addresses are gone in both the app and an export.
You charged us twice, and after our plan change the saved contact history disappeared. We checked the same workspace and still cannot find it. Please call me; restoring the history matters most.
Several attachments that I previously saved to contact records now say file not found. They are still missing after sign-out and sign-in. Other contact fields look normal.
My saved custom tags and the contact assignments attached to them are no longer in the workspace. They were there this morning. I have tried the normal view and search. Can you call me?
Please explain the difference between your monthly and annual subscription prices. The contact manager works normally and all our saved records are present.
The invoice shows two charges for this month. The app and our contact records are fine. Please phone me about getting the duplicate charge refunded.
I can view and edit every saved contact, but Export CSV fails on each attempt. I cannot complete our required export today. Nothing has disappeared.
When I try to sign in, my password reset link says expired immediately. I cannot access the app. I am not claiming any records are missing. Please call me.
The sidebar icon is the wrong color after the update. All buttons still work and my saved contacts are unchanged. This is only a cosmetic issue.
Every person on our team gets a server error when opening any workspace, and nobody can use the app. We have no evidence of missing records. Could support call me?
Would you consider adding a keyboard shortcut for creating contact groups? I can create groups with the mouse and have no current problem.
I have an idea for a partnership integrating our event platform with your product. Everything is working; please call me if your partnerships team is interested.
No saved contacts are missing. The search box returns no results because it is broken, but I can see every contact in the full list. I cannot finish the search task. Please call me.
If I import a CSV next month, could it erase my saved contacts? I have not imported anything and nothing is missing. I only want general advice before deciding.

Earlier I thought all my saved contacts had disappeared. I found that a filter was hiding them, cleared it, and confirmed every record is back. No problem remains; this is a follow-up to close my technical ticket.
I typed a new contact into a form but never clicked Save. The tab closed and that unsaved draft was lost. I entered it again successfully; all previously saved records are intact.
I first assumed a filter was hiding my contacts, but I have now cleared every filter and confirmed the correct workspace. Three contacts saved yesterday are still missing. Please call me.
Our previous vendor lost our contacts last year. That never happened in your contact manager; all current records are safe. My actual issue with you is a duplicate subscription charge.
This workspace list is empty. I cannot remember whether I saved any contacts here or whether this is a new workspace. I cannot continue the import task until support helps me check.

Two teammates checked the same saved contact list at the same time. One says every record is present; the other says every saved record is gone. We do not know which observation is right or whether any work is blocked. Please call us to investigate.
